entry.title: Transportation · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Budget, External Agencies, Planning, and Parking. The City Manager scheduled four 15-minute briefings covering the September monthly budget report, external agency updates, planning, building and development, and parking fee compendium and ordinance changes from the parking study.
Proposed: Performance Agreement for Salem Avenue Parking Structure. The agenda recommended action on executing a performance agreement between the City, the Economic Development Authority of the City of Roanoke, and Shadwell Properties, LLC, for costs associated with securing the parking structure at 33 Salem Avenue SW.

entry.title: Transportation · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Support for Smart Scale 2026 Applications. Council approved a resolution expressing support for Smart Scale 2026 applications. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Comments on Completed Gainsboro Road Complete Streets Project. The City Manager announced the completion of the Gainsboro Road Complete Streets project, which added pedestrian signals, safer crossings, ADA-accessible ramps, and bike and scooter accommodations.
Discussion / report: Report on Valley Metro Transit Projects and Fare Structure. Mayor Cobb reported that the Valley View Walmart bus shelter is scheduled to open in mid-August and that a new bus fare structure for Valley Metro will take effect in January 2027.
Adopted: Street Renaming of 2nd Street NE to Bethel Davis Street NE. Following a public hearing on a request by Ricardo Stovall to honor Evelyn Bethel and Helen Davis, the Council adopted an ordinance renaming 2nd Street NE (between Madison Avenue NE and Gilmer Avenue NE) to Bethel Davis Street NE. Recorded vote: 7-0.

entry.title: Transportation · Mon, Jun 15, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Water Authority Funds for Wasena Bridge Replacement. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating funds from the Western Virginia Water Authority for utility work associated with the Wasena Bridge Replacement project. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Adopted: Towing Advisory Board Membership Amendments. Council adopted an ordinance amending Section 2-321(a) of the City Code to alter the number of members and makeup of the Towing Advisory Board. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Proposed: Pedestrianization Initiative for Market Street and Wall Street. Council Member Volosin submitted a Council Member Initiative to pedestrianize Market Street and Wall Street in downtown, aiming to discuss it at the July Council meeting alongside downtown business stakeholders.

entry.title: Transportation · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Capital Project Updates: Riverland Road/Star Trail and Westside Boulevard/Salem Turnpike. The City Manager presented infrastructure updates on the Riverland Road/Star Trail Connection Project, noting major drainage installations and a planned pedestrian link, as well as the Westside Boulevard/Salem Turnpike Pedestrian Improvements Project, which is progressing to curb, sidewalk, and pavement restoration.
Adopted: Fare Free Election Day Bus Service for 2026. City Council passed Resolution No. 43395-051826 approving and ratifying the Greater Roanoke Transit Company's implementation of fare-free bus service on election days in April, August, and November 2026. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Complete Streets Policy Updates and Comprehensive Plan Incorporation. Council adopted Ordinance No. 43398-051826 incorporating Complete Streets Policy updates and the Safety Action Plan/Speed Management Action Plan into City Plan 2040. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Adoption of 2026 Safety Action and Speed Management Action Plans. Council adopted Resolution No. 43399-051826 formally adopting the 2026 Safety Action and Speed Management Action Plans. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6490,plainText=false)

entry.title: Transportation · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Authorization to Request VDOT TA Program Funds for Salem Turnpike Project. Council adopted a resolution authorizing the request for Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program funds for Salem Turnpike from 36th Street to Westwood Boulevard. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Fiscal Year 2027 VDOT Annual Street Payments Acceptance and Appropriation. Council approved an ordinance to accept and appropriate the Fiscal Year 2027 Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) annual street payments for the City of Roanoke. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDOT Revenue Sharing Agreements Acceptance and Rescissions for Multiple Projects. City Council adopted an ordinance authorizing the acceptance and rescission of Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) revenue sharing funds and the execution of agreements for multiple projects. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Comments on Leadership Retreat, Wasena Bridge, and Emergency Preparedness. The City Manager provided updates reporting on a department directors' leadership retreat held at RoVa Labs on September 2-3, progress on the Wasena Bridge Replacement project (approximately 95% complete with reopening expected in the coming weeks), and activities for National Preparedness Month involving Emergency Management and Stormwater teams.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6556,plainText=false)

entry.title: Transportation · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Alcohol. City Council approved the acceptance and appropriation of a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant focused on alcohol enforcement and safety. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Police Traffic Services. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant for police traffic services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Report on Gilmer Traffic Calming Project. The City Manager reported on the Gilmer Traffic Calming Project, noting that staff worked with community volunteers and local artists to prepare five sites and complete the first of five street murals honoring the Star City Medical Society and Black medical professionals from the Jim Crow era.
Discussion / report: Public Matters Follow-Up on Northwest Greenway Connectivity and Safety Action Plan. Staff reported following up with a resident from the August 17 meeting regarding greenway connectivity in northwest Roanoke and the Safety Action Plan. The resident was connected with the Safe Streets for All and Vision Zero Coordinator to identify safer routes on greenways and 25 mph roads, as well as the Loudon-Melrose Neighborhood Association.
Discussion / report: Public Matters Follow-Up on Wilmont Park Area Curbing and Stormwater Runoff. Staff followed up on a resident's inquiry regarding curbing and stormwater runoff in the Wilmont Park area. Stormwater staff determined the runoff is caused by the private driveway's grade and that curb and gutter installation would only be aesthetic rather than solve the problem, offering the owner options for handling the driveway runoff.

entry.title: Transportation · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: FY2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43483-101926, accepting and appropriating the FY2027 Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Highway Safety Grant for the Roanoke Traffic Safety Awareness Campaign. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Public Follow-Up on Valley Metro Bus Route 15. Communications Manager Carol Corbin reported on a public inquiry regarding a direct route on the 15 bus to the Valley View Walmart. Valley Metro officials are examining potential route adjustments and confirmed current transfer options and paratransit services.
Discussion / report: Public Follow-Up on City Street Design Manual Update. In response to concerns raised about the age of the Street Design Manual, staff reported that Public Works is updating the manual and currently adheres to current federal, state, and NACTO design guidance.
Discussion / report: Proposed Committees for Railroad Transition and Onzlee Ware Plaza. Council Member Volosin suggested forming a Railroad Transition Committee regarding the Norfolk Southern and Union Pacific merger, as well as a committee for the state-funded Onzlee Ware Plaza at the courthouse. Mayor Cobb advised establishing an appointment process.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6588,plainText=false)
